title: Inspiration of Scripture
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The inspiration of Scripture means that the Bible is God-breathed, given through human authors by the work of the Holy Spirit. Scripture is not merely human religious thought; it is God’s Word written for His people.
summary: The inspiration of Scripture means that the Bible is God-breathed, given through human authors by the work of the Holy Spirit. Scripture is not merely human religious thought; it is God’s Word written for His people.
christFocus: Jesus Christ honored Scripture as the Word of God, fulfilled what was written, and taught His followers to live by God’s Word. The inspired Scriptures bear witness to Him, reveal His saving work, and lead sinners to faith and obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture comes from God. Though written through real human authors in real times, places, languages, and situations, the Bible is not merely a human product. God worked by His Spirit so that what was written is truly His Word.

Inspiration does not erase the personalities, histories, or styles of the biblical writers. God used them without surrendering His authority over the message. The result is Scripture that speaks with divine authority, truthfulness, and purpose.

Because Scripture is inspired by God, it is profitable for teaching, reproof, correction, and training in righteousness. God gave His Word so His people would know Him, trust Him, be corrected by Him, and be equipped for faithful obedience.

The inspiration of Scripture also guards the church from treating the Bible as optional advice. When Scripture speaks, God speaks. The believer does not stand over the Word as judge, but under the Word as servant.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
If Scripture is only human opinion, then people are left to decide truth by culture, feelings, religious tradition, wounds, or personal preference. But if Scripture is God-breathed, then God has lovingly and authoritatively spoken to His people.

This doctrine gives confidence to the weak, correction to the wandering, courage to the teacher, and stability to the church. God has not left His people guessing. He has given a Word that can be trusted, preached, obeyed, and lived.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive Scripture as God’s own Word. Read it with reverence, study it with humility, obey it with faith, and teach it with care. Do not treat the Bible as a tool to support your opinions; let the Lord use His inspired Word to shape your mind, expose your sin, strengthen your faith, and lead you to Christ.
